title: updateGuardian
description: Formal spec §7.6. Replaces the `keys` of the entry for `guardian` (REQ-7-16).

guardian.description: REQ-7-15: the DID of a current guardian or of the successor.

keys.description: REQ-7-16: replaces that entry's own `keys` -- 1 to 8 distinct Multikey strings (REQ-6-2/REQ-5-8).

proof.description: REQ-7-6: every key in `keys`; and either a key in the named entry, or one current key together with one guardian other than the named one.
